title: SmartBuild Deck Plan (v5)
description: Canonical source of truth for all deck DECISIONS. Every pass (PLAN/BUILD/REFINE/BRAND/SWEEP/EXPORT) reads and writes only this file for decisions; generated HTML, resolved-asset manifests, sweep reports and exports are derived artifacts tracked in the run manifest. UUID lifecycle: a NEW block created after PLAN mints a fresh block_uuid; an EDITED block keeps its uuid; a DELETED block is tombstoned (status='deleted', retained so pins resolve to 'target removed'); a SPLIT keeps the original uuid on the primary fragment and mints new uuids for the rest; a MERGE keeps one survivor uuid and tombstones the others. uuids are unique per plan and never re-minted.

schema_version.description: Schema version. A migration step must run before a pass consumes a plan whose schema_version is older than the engine's.

plan_revision.description: Monotonic revision. Bumped on every atomic write. Used for stale-pin detection and rollback, not mutual exclusion (single sequential writer).

stage.description: Pipeline stage this deck has reached: 1 PLAN, 2 BUILD, 3 REFINE, 4 BRAND & SWEEP, 5 EXPORT. Each pass bumps it to its own number on completion. build.py stamps a cover-slide stage ribbon for stages 1-3 (internal drafts); at stages 4-5 no ribbon (deck is client-shareable/external-ready).

audience.description: client => hard license gate: EXPORT blocked unless every resolved asset is approved_for_client.

theme_locked.description: Set true during REFINE once the human picks the final light/dark theme. Locks the deck to `theme` as the single decided version: the build drops the light/dark toggle from the chrome, and EXPORT uses `theme` with no prompt.

approved_facts.description: Human-approved factual claims / statistics. Captured at PLAN, editable only inside an approved REFINE scope. SWEEP's content-fidelity gate compares rendered claims to this set and hard-fails on any new/altered fact not covered by an approved scope.

value.description: Normalized value for exact matching, e.g. '93%', '$2B+', '500+'.

source.description: Where this fact came from / who approved it.

resolved_assets.description: Filled at BRAND from what was ACTUALLY injected (not planned intent). Drives the Sources manifest and the client license gate.

display_index.description: Derived display-only label (s10). NEVER an identifier.

variant_choice.description: Reviewer's chosen 'main version' for a slide that bakes both a light and dark render (recorded via the review Slide Board); build stamps data-variant on the section.

family.description: A template id from the layout library catalog (layouts/library-v9/catalog.json), e.g. 'CV-11', 'NM-01', 'AN-09'. Use 'custom' for an invented layout (deck-local until review-promoted). build.py checks membership against the catalog and warns on unknown ids.

shape_tags.description: Shape descriptors for relationship-driven variety (item-count, orientation, is-flow). Same group => reuse shape; new group => different shape from previous group.

templateVersion.description: Optional. The layout-template version this slide CONSUMED (the catalog `version` at build time). Stamps what the deck actually used, so a later master-template bump (via the stage-gate, see layouts/GATE.md) never silently changes an in-flight deck. build.py records this per slide in the run manifest; if absent, the manifest falls back to the current catalog version.

provenance.description: Optional. Reference-library / deck-archive lineage when a slide's CONTENT was reused from a published, reviewed source rather than authored fresh. Carried through into the run manifest by build.py. Absent on freshly-authored slides.

theme.description: Optional per-slide theme override; defaults to the deck theme.

reference.description: Marks this slide as a VERBATIM-LOCKED reuse of an exec-approved reference slide. build.py replaces the slide's rendered stage with the entry's locked HTML for the deck theme (word/image/style-for-style; only light<->dark swaps). Content is locked: REFINE/SWEEP/fidelity do NOT content-edit or re-check it. content_blocks still carry the text for search/attribution.

group.description: Sequence id. Slides sharing a group are a connected sequence and should share a layout shape.

continues.description: True if this slide continues the previous slide's idea (continuity signal).

tag.description: Topic tag looked up in libraries/images/catalog.json (owned images resolve by this tag FIRST).

query.description: Search phrase for the Unsplash FALLBACK when no owned image matches the tag (BRAND uses it to find a photo).

resolved.description: The specific image chosen for this slot, recorded at BRAND so it is a stable decision (not re-picked each build). Owned images ALWAYS take priority; a resolved Unsplash entry is only written when no owned image fits.

url.description: Full images.unsplash.com URL of the chosen photo (build.py downloads + embeds this as a data-URI).

approved_for_client.description: Whether this image may ship on a client deck (license gate).

represents.description: What concept this icon conveys — used by SWEEP's icon-relevance check.

status.description: 'deleted' = tombstoned; retained so pins resolve to 'target removed'.

fact_refs.description: approved_facts ids whose claim/stat appears in this block. Lets the content-fidelity gate map rendered claims back to approved facts.

text_html.description: Rich inline HTML (bold/italic/underline/colour/highlight/line-breaks) authored via the live editor. When present the renderer uses it VERBATIM instead of brandify(text); `text` stays as the plain-text fallback (fidelity/search/PPTX). Sanitised to an allowlist of formatting tags/styles on save.

block_uuid.description: The element the pin anchors to (id-primary). Survives reorders/inserts/deletes.

description.description: Auto-captured: element type + current text + slide/section, at drop time.

content_hash.description: Hash of the anchored block at drop time. On rebuild, mismatch => pin flagged 'stale' for re-confirmation, not silently applied.

requires_attribution.description: If true anywhere, Sources is forced visible + exported, or EXPORT is blocked.

approved_for_client.description: client decks: EXPORT blocked unless every asset is true.

provenance.description: Reference-library / deck-archive lineage for a REUSED slide's content. Recorded when PLAN searches-and-reuses published, reviewed content (About SmartBuild, bios, etc.) instead of reinventing it. The reference-library master is itself versioned and stage-gated (see layouts/GATE.md): entries bump their version on approved change, and a reusing deck stamps the `ref_version` it consumed — the same never-auto-flow-down rule as templates.

source.description: Which store the content came from: the curated reference-slide library, or the archive of past decks.

ref_id.description: Id of the reused reference entry / archived slide, e.g. 'ref-about-smartbuild'.

ref_version.description: Version of the reference entry CONSUMED at build time (stamped so a later gated bump does not silently alter this deck).

blocks_hash.description: SWEEP drift baseline: reference_search.blocks_hash() of the reused content (active block texts) AT PULL TIME. On every SWEEP, validate.drift_advisories recomputes it for the current slide and, on mismatch, raises a NON-blocking advisory to bank the edit upward via the gate. Absent => drift check skips this slide (back-compat).

reuse.description: Whether the reused content was pulled verbatim or adapted on insert.

title.description: Human-readable label for the reused content.

reused_at_revision.description: plan_revision at which this content was pulled in.
